tasks.short: Read pattern drawings and determine machine setups

steps.what: Locate current blueprints, drawings and written specifications
Read drawings to determine pattern sizes, shapes and allowances
Determine required machine setups from the interpreted geometry
Annotate working drawings with the selected sizes and setup requirements

tasks.design: Use a native job-document view and reusable annotation labels in {DOCS}. The patternmaker reads the drawings, resolves allowances and chooses machine setups, then separately writes the existing working annotations.
tasks.previous_blocker: Locating the current revision and repeating annotation labels add small handling costs.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing document views and annotation presets can remove those operations without interpreting geometry automatically.
tasks.still_hard: Drawing ambiguities, casting allowances and machine limitations require practical judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Translate the design into a workable pattern and setup.
tasks.altitude: Reduce drawing handling while retaining pattern interpretation.

reach.learn: Resolve ambiguous requirements before choosing setup dimensions

evidence.claim: Native document views and annotation presets can remove navigation and repeated labels; local effects are unmeasured.

assumptions: The worker already uses marked working drawings during setup. No new setup report or approval record is introduced; absent existing annotation work there is no s4 saving.
The patternmaker produces job revision in s1 and sizes, shapes, units, allowances and setup choices in s2-s4, with reading and capture time counted. Missing dimensions require manual clarification.

The document view removes 1.5 of 15 retrieval hours; annotation presets separately remove 1.5 hours of label repetition from s4. Actual dimensions and setup content remain written and checked by the worker.
Ordinary same-system saves remain retained without approval. Current revision checking remains within s1; stable native presets require no separate recurring work.
unknowns: Whether current documents are already directly accessible
research_questions: Can the proposed labels and view remove repeated actions without changing dimensional interpretation?

already_counted.description: Write and check the working drawing annotations

incremental.description: No separate administration for fixed native labels and views

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 central B=100, R=97 and zero upkeep gives 3 net. Conservative case: drawings are already indexed and annotations already use standard labels, retaining all 100 hours. Compatible revision metadata removing 0.5 retrieval hour and usable label presets removing 1.5 writing hours retain 98 hours and give 2 net. Both interpretation steps remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Divide wooden patterns for removal from molds

steps.what: Inspect casting shapes and identify potential removal constraints
Choose pattern sections and their removal sequence
Mark section boundaries on the physical pattern
Divide patterns into the chosen sections
Check section fit and the proposed removal path

tasks.design: Retain inspection, section choice, physical marking, division and fit checking with the patternmaker. No supported software action replaces the pattern work.
tasks.previous_blocker: Sectioning depends on physical geometry and practical mould-removal judgement.
tasks.enabler_now: No evidenced change removes one of these named operations.
tasks.still_hard: Undercuts, fragile sections and alignment must be judged together.
tasks.human_edge: Choose a section arrangement that can be made and removed intact.

reach.task: Remove the pattern without damaging the mold
reach.learn: Anticipate withdrawal direction and section handling

evidence.claim: Document templates do not replace physical marking, section division or fit checking in this case.

assumptions: The actual marking artefact is split into s3 rather than hidden inside judgement. It is a physical work mark, not a typed record; no administrative sectioning log is introduced.
The patternmaker produces constraints by inspection in s1 and chosen boundaries in s2, with their time retained. No hidden structured geometry feed or automatic simulation is assumed.
A native view, template or setting does not place or verify the physical marks. This case has no existing digital section drawing to regenerate.
No new tool or administration is introduced, so incremental work is zero.
unknowns: Whether a particular workshop uses a separate digital section drawing
research_questions: Does observation reveal any actual repetitive drawing write inside this sectioning task?

already_counted.description: Mark the pattern and check the section arrangement

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B=100, R=100 and zero new upkeep. Conservative and favourable cases retain all physical observation, section choice, marking, division and fit checking. A workshop with digital section drawings would need a different measured baseline.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Correct wooden patterns for casting defects

steps.what: Inspect casting defects and compare the affected wooden pattern
Locate the current drawing and relevant casting allowance information
Determine the correction needed to compensate for defects
Correct the pattern by the selected physical alteration
Check the altered pattern against the intended correction

tasks.design: Use the native job reference index in {DOCS} to locate existing drawings and allowance information. The patternmaker determines the cause, chooses the correction, alters the physical pattern and checks it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reference navigation repeats between defect inspection and physical correction.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing document indexing can remove a small navigation burden without inferring defect causation.
tasks.still_hard: The same casting defect can arise from causes that a pattern change will not fix.
tasks.human_edge: Choose a correction that addresses the actual defect rather than its appearance alone.
tasks.altitude: Reduce reference handling while retaining physical correction skill.

reach.learn: Distinguish pattern effects from process-related defects

evidence.claim: Native document indexing can reduce repeated lookup without diagnosing a casting defect.

assumptions: The corrected pattern is the task's existing artefact. No correction report or activity log is added because the statement does not require one and no current reader is established.

The worker produces observed defect location and pattern identity in s1 and checks revision and allowance applicability in s2; capture is counted. Missing references or unexplained defects require manual investigation.
The native index removes 1.5 of 15 existing reference-navigation hours. All cause interpretation, physical alteration and checking remain retained.
Current-reference checks remain within s2; no new recurring administration is introduced. Drawing lookup overlapping 12230 is allocated only once on an actual job.
unknowns: How often correction work includes reference navigation
research_questions: Which current correction cases contain the assumed navigation burden?

already_counted.description: Inspect the actual defect and verify the physical correction

incremental.description: No separate recurring work for the native index

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 central B=100, R=98.5, zero upkeep gives 1.5 net. Conservative case: the relevant drawing is already open or the allowance reference needs full manual investigation, retaining all 100 hours. Where indexed revision metadata removes one lookup hour, 99 hours remain and 1 net is possible. Physical correction labour is fully retained in both cases.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Define the patternmaking job scope and difficult production features
Determine material quantities, labour allowances and applicable cost rates
Calculate patternmaking costs from quantities, allowances and rates
Write estimate assumptions, scope qualifications and exclusions
Review the estimate for omitted work and unrealistic allowances

tasks.design: Configure rate lookups and cost formulas in {SPREADSHEET}, with reusable estimate sections in {DOCS}. The patternmaker determines labour allowances and material needs, writes job-specific qualifications and checks the resulting estimate.
tasks.previous_blocker: Rate navigation, arithmetic and repeated estimate wording consume time alongside judgement.
tasks.enabler_now: Native lookup tables, formulas and document templates can remove those specified operations.
tasks.still_hard: Unusual geometry, rework and production uncertainty determine the allowance quality.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise work that a simple quantity-times-rate calculation misses.
tasks.altitude: Separate cost arithmetic from the judgement that makes an estimate credible.

reach.learn: Keep allowances and exclusions traceable to actual job features

evidence.claim: Spreadsheet lookups and explicit formulas can calculate specified costs without deciding labour allowances.

assumptions: The task ends at a checked internal estimate. A customer quotation send is not stated and is not introduced. The estimate is the existing work product.

The patternmaker produces material quantities, units, selected rate dates, labour hours, overhead rules and exclusions in s1-s2; capture and checking are counted. Missing rates or unsupported allowances return to manual estimation.
Rate-table lookup removes 3 of 30 input-preparation hours; reusable standard terms remove 3 of 15 writing hours. The two cuts correspond to different removed actions.
The 25-hour calculation baseline is actual manual arithmetic and transfer work. Existing automatic calculation runtime and ordinary same-system saves have no eligible labour benefit.
unknowns: How much calculation is already automated
Availability of current rates and comparable labour allowances
research_questions: Does the configured sheet reproduce independently checked estimates while exposing exclusions and uncertain allowances?

already_counted.description: Prepare job-specific estimate qualifications and check completeness

incremental.description: Maintain rate tables and test costing formulas

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 central B=100, R=69, gross 31 less 2 upkeep gives 29 net. Conservative case: non-comparable allowances retain all 30 preparation hours, existing automation leaves 5 calculation hours removable, and unique qualifications retain all 15 writing hours; other 30 and 2 upkeep give 3 net. With usable rate metadata retaining 28 preparation, 7 calculation and 13 writing hours plus other 30 and 2 upkeep, 20 net remains. No flat discount is applied to all eligible benefits.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Preserve pattern geometry and practical judgement while reducing repeated reference handling and costing.
reach: Connect foundry requirements with workable patterns
Work with estimators on explicit allowances
skills_to_grow: Trace drawing revisions and casting allowances
Distinguish physical pattern marks from administrative records
role.ambitious_version: A wood patternmaker who retains hands-on quality and produces clearer, traceable cost estimates.
